material_findings.finding: The proper-lift criterion, proper/smooth base-change table, and sufficient open/closed inclusion directions have partial forms on scan009 and scan012.

Scan014 explicitly separates proper/smooth Serre properties from strict categorical cofibration/fibration; scans011–012 provide comma replacements with a stated not-yet-Serre limitation, not the later endpoint models.

Scan029 explicitly identifies unbounded lengths of elementary homotopies in an infinite family; this supports a close analogy with the later bounded-winding obstruction, without supplying its circle-poset or Kaledin claims.
Scans024–026 give finite factorization/pushout/interval conditions for left fractions; they do not state the later intrinsic cofibration axioms or rectification theorems.

The product/diagonal usage of total asphericity on scans033–036 must not be identified with the later all-outgoing-functors definition; XII §V.2.3, Definition1, ms.88–89 contains an explicit terminology warning.
The dossier claims that the CATHOT E.26 comparisons are settled, while RESULTS_STATE still labels CATHOT E.26 Open; this is a supplied-record status tension, not a mathematical adjudication from 118.
